cockroach:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: production animation sprite atlas for a desktop pet. REALISTIC MACRO PHOTO insect, natural anatomy and texture, NOT cute stylization, NOT cartoon, no human face, no accessories. True transparent alpha background. Exact layout: FOUR columns by NINE rows = 36 separate full-body insects, portrait aspect ratio 4:9, desired 1024x2304. Invisible equal square cells. Entire insect including every antenna, leg and wing remains inside its own cell with at least 25% empty margin around the silhouette. All rows and columns separated by fully transparent gutters. Each subject at identical scale, fixed camera, crisp fine edges, soft neutral lighting, no floor/shadow/text/labels/grid. Four sequential subtle motion phases per row, left to right. Keep anatomical features consistent between frames. Subject: a realistic reddish dark brown cockroach, shiny oval wing covers, dark head under rounded pronotum, six spiny jointed legs, two long slender sweeping antennae, small tail cerci. Warm mahogany shell highlights. Slightly elevated three-quarter macro view, entire insect readable from above. Body plus antennae span at most 60% cell width. Rows: 1 idle facing slightly right, four subtle antenna sway phases; 2 crawling RIGHT, body points right in all frames, alternating tripod leg gait; 3 crawling LEFT, body points left in all frames, alternating gait; 4 raises one front leg and waves antennae; 5 brief scuttle/lift and return, wings remain closed; 6 crouches low, antennae dip then recover; 7 resting with legs tucked slightly and antennae calm; 8 grooming front legs and antennae; 9 alert antenna sweep, raises forebody slightly. Exactly 36 complete isolated cockroaches, no extra objects or motion streaks.
CRITICAL SPACING: make each entire insect INCLUDING its longest antennae SMALL, only 110px total across inside each 256px square. Each antenna is gently curved toward the body. NO extremity near cell edge. EMPTY space of at least 60px on ALL sides of EVERY insect. Plenty of transparent space between all 36 insects. Strict uniform grid, small centered specimens. Real cockroach small head and eyes, long flattened oval body, not a beetle.
